Messages.Author: ek letters
Messages.Body:
A suggestion has been made that we may have been misplaying the untap
option of Cat's Guidance. Is this card played
A) As the attempt to block is declared
B) When the intercept/Stealth battle is over (so an actual block
is taking place)
C) When the actual battle is complete (so you know whether the blockig
minion will be around to untap)
D) When the next action is declared by any methusala's minion, thus
giving you a potential blocker as a suprise
E) Whenever your cat leaps onto your cards

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ek letters <lanc...@delphi.com> writes:



Tom's official answer to this is B.
Our house rule is C.
